ARRANGE.e: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
ARRANGE.k: From Old French 'arengier', to put in a row.

COMRADE.t: A friend or companion, especially in a struggle.
COMRADE.e: He fought beside his comrade in the war.

KISSING.t: Touching someone with the lips to show love.
KISSING.e: The couple was kissing under the tree.

CLASSIC.t: Judged over time to be of the highest quality.
CLASSIC.e: This novel is a true classic of literature.
CLASSIC.k: From Latin 'classicus', of the highest class.

SELFISH.t: Caring only about yourself and not others.
SELFISH.e: It was selfish of him to take all the food.

THERAPY.t: Treatment to help with illness or emotional problems.
THERAPY.e: She went to therapy to deal with her stress.

SERVANT.t: A person employed to work in another's house.
SERVANT.e: The servant brought tea to the guests.

PAINFUL.e: The injection was quick but painful.

STEPHEN.t: A male given name of Greek origin.
STEPHEN.e: Stephen plays the guitar in a band.

DRAWING.t: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon.
DRAWING.e: The child made a drawing of her family.

REALISE.t: To become fully aware of something as a fact.
REALISE.e: She began to realise how late it was.

TORTURE.t: The act of causing severe pain to punish someone.

BLESSED.t: Made holy, or having good fortune.
BLESSED.e: They felt blessed to have such a happy family.

REBECCA.t: A female given name of Hebrew origin.
REBECCA.e: Rebecca sang beautifully at the concert.

BARBARA.t: A female given name of Greek origin.
BARBARA.e: Barbara planted roses in her garden.

REMOVED.t: Took something away from a place.
REMOVED.e: He removed his hat before entering.

CRYSTAL.t: A clear, hard mineral or a female given name.
CRYSTAL.e: The clear crystal sparkled in the light.

CONFIRM.t: To state that something is definitely true.
CONFIRM.e: Please confirm your appointment by phone.

SCRATCH.t: To rub the skin with nails, or make a thin mark.
SCRATCH.e: The cat left a scratch on the wooden door.

REMINDS.e: This song reminds me of my childhood.

CONTEST.t: A competition to see who is best.
CONTEST.e: She won first place in the singing contest.
CONTEST.k: From Latin 'contestari', to call to witness.

DISTANT.t: Far away in space or time.
DISTANT.e: They could see distant mountains on the horizon.

MURDERS.t: The crimes of killing people on purpose.

PLAYERS.t: People who take part in a game or sport.
PLAYERS.e: The team has eleven players on the field.

CHARGED.t: Formally accused of a crime, or filled with electricity.
CHARGED.e: He was charged with driving too fast.

SERVED.t: Past form of giving food, help, or duty to others
SERVED.e: The waiter served our dinner with a smile.
